schema.app_description: Instantly sort lists, words, or phrases in alphabetical (A-Z) or reverse order (Z-A). Supports line breaks, commas, and complex sentences. Fast and easy with Tap to Tool.

schema.howto_description: The Alphabetizer is a free online tool that organizes any list of words, phrases, or items in alphabetical order.
schema.step1_text: Copy and paste or type your items (separated by spaces, commas, or line breaks) into the input area.
schema.step2_text: The list will be automatically sorted A-Z in the result field, preserving your original separator format.

content.intro_text: The fastest and simplest tool to put any list of words, names, or phrases in alphabetical order.
content.usage_title: How to Use the Alphabetize Tool?
content.step_1: Enter Your List: Copy and paste or type the items you want to organize into the designated text area. Items can be separated by line breaks, commas, or spaces.
content.step_2: Automatic Sorting: The tool does all the work for you and sorts the items alphabetically (A-Z or Z-A).
content.step_3: Copy Result: The sorted text appears instantly in the result field, maintaining the original separator for easy copying.
content.benefits_intro: An alphabetizing tool is extremely useful for:
content.benefit_1_text: Quickly organize lists of names, codes, inventories, or any dataset for easy reference.
content.benefit_2_text: Create bibliographies, glossaries, or vocabularies in standard alphabetical order.
content.benefit_3_text: Classify keywords, tags, or complex phrases (like 'peanut butter') as single items without breaking them apart.
content.benefit_4_text: Ensure all documents or lists follow the same sorting standard, eliminating human error.
content.footer_text: Organize your lists and boost your productivity with the Alphabetical Order Tool!
